content:
We will be updating LeanSearch on this Friday (Apr 4). We will be using database constructed from mathlib v4.16.0, and the API will be changed.

The source code used to construct the entire database is now open source. You can find it at https://github.com/frenzymath/LeanSearch. The new API format is illustrated here. Note that for a single request you still need to pass a list of length one.

The informalized database is also publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/FrenzyMath/mathlib_informal_v4.16.0.
The update is now complete. You can additionally find API docs at https://leansearch.net/docs and OpenAPI specification at https://leansearch.net/openapi.json.
